newsitem.title: USA: Ravenswood hikes prices on alloy sheet/coil.
newsitem.headline: Ravenswood hikes prices on alloy sheet/coil.

text.p: Ravenswood Aluminum, part of Century Aluminum, said it raised its prices by five percent on common alloy sheet and by three percent for trailer roof coil.
The increases are effective with orders received on or after Jan 14, and with all orders scheduled to be shipped March 1 and later, regardless of order entry date.
Ravenswood previously announced price hikes of three to 15 percent on plate, coil and sheet products mid-December.
